cwp_africa.1 = {
	type = country_event
	placement = root
	duration = 3

	title = cwp_africa.1.t
	desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.d_gbr
				trigger = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.d_glc
			}
		}
	}
	flavor = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.f_gbr
				trigger = { c:GBR ?= this }
			}
			triggered_desc = {
				desc = cwp_africa.1.f_glc
			}
		}
	}

	event_image = {
		video = "africa_leader_arguing"
	}
	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"
	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/waving_flag.dds"

	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.1.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

	}

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_election.dds"

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won } }
			set_global_variable = cwp_gold_election_won
			remove_global_variable = cwp_gold_campaign_running
			c:GLC ?= { add_liberty_desire = 10 }
			c:GBR ?= { trigger_event = { id = cwp_africa.4 popup = yes } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = cwp_africa.4.a
		default_option = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
